sandbox_source.note: Third-party npm repackaging used ONLY because huggingface.co is unreachable from the build sandbox. Provenance of the weights is therefore claimed by the packager, not verified by us. Re-download onnx/model.onnx and tokenizer.json from huggingface.co at the revision above on an unrestricted machine and compare sha256 (see docs/MODEL.md).

note_hand_written: config.json and tokenizer_config.json are hand-written and committed; they are pinned here because they change model behaviour (e.g. model_max_length).
